title: Maximize Consecutive Elements in an Array After Modification
summary: Given a 0-indexed array of positive integers, you can increase any element by at most 1.
statement: Given a 0-indexed array of positive integers, you can increase any element by at most 1. Then, select one or more consecutive elements from the modified array. Determine the greatest number of such consecutive elements you can choose.
constraints: nums is a nonempty positive-integer array.
Each element may independently stay unchanged or increase by exactly one before selection.
Choose the largest subset whose sorted values are distinct consecutive integers.
reference_solution:
def maximum_modified_consecutive_elements(nums):
    best={};answer=1
    for value in sorted(nums):
        extended=best.get(value,0)+1
        best[value]=max(best.get(value,0),best.get(value-1,0)+1)
        best[value+1]=max(best.get(value+1,0),extended)
        answer=max(answer,best[value],best[value+1])
    return answer

Track the best chain length by final endpoint and update both choices using pre-update states.

Sorting ensures all earlier chain elements are available, and the two transitions exhaust the allowed final value of each processed element.
